rows.summary: Synthesized preliminary experimental and theoretical foundations for distinguishing chemical memory from passive hysteresis in autocatalytic networks.
rows.title: WAKE✳︎ Research Journal: Autocatalytic Memory Systems

rows.summary: This update initiates a formal research project under the autocatalytic_memory topic to investigate experimental evidence distinguishing simple hysteresis from functional memory in chemical reaction networks. Previous theoretical frameworks have proposed that history-dependence can arise in non-equilibrium autocatalytic systems, but empirical validation remains limited. This research phase seeks to identify specific synthetic demonstrations where chemical networks maintain state across perturbations, moving beyond theoretical models to evaluate if these states constitute functional memory capable of supporting selection. The heredity_thresholds project remains parked pending these results.
